{"subject":"Congrats on the Modern Treasury partnership","body":"Hi,

Congrats on the Modern Treasury partnership announced in June. Bringing Sardine's real-time transaction monitoring and fraud prevention into a payments platform that serves businesses moving money across US and international rails is a meaningful step.

If it's useful, I'd love to grab 20 minutes to hear how the integration is going and what you're focused on next. Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Priya"}
